result.summary: The image shows a wide multi-lane intersection adjacent to a commercial area with marked zebra crosswalks. While basic pedestrian infrastructure like sidewalks and markings are present, the long crossing distances and wide turning radii create significant exposure for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for an extended period across multiple lanes.
hazards.location_in_image: Main intersection crossing in the foreground

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radii
hazards.description: The intersection geometry allows vehicles to make turns at higher speeds, increasing risk to pedestrians in the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Right-hand turn area from the foreground into the side street

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to provide a safe waiting area and reduce the effective crossing distance for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The environment is a high-capacity, car-oriented intersection adjacent to a commercial area. While marked crosswalks and a median refuge are present, the long crossing distances and high-speed right-turn slip lane create significant hazards for pedestrians.

hazards.name: High-speed slip lane
hazards.description: A wide, sweeping right-turn slip lane allows vehicles to maintain high speeds while turning, creating a dangerous conflict point for pedestrians crossing to the island.

hazards.name: Excessive crossing distance
hazards.description: The multi-lane arterial road requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for a long duration, increasing the risk of conflict.
hazards.location_in_image: Center crossing across the main roadway

interventions.title: Slip Lane Reconstruction
interventions.description: Reconstruct the slip lane with a sharper entry angle or a truck apron to force vehicles to slow down before the pedestrian crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to reduce the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Pedestrian Signals
interventions.description: Ensure countdown pedestrian signals are installed and visible to provide clear information to people crossing the wide intersection.

result.summary: The image shows a large, multi-lane signalized intersection with a car-centric design. It features a high-speed slip lane and long crossing distances, which significantly increase pedestrian exposure and risk.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to cross multiple lanes of traffic, increasing exposure time to vehicles.

hazards.name: High-Speed Slip Lane
hazards.description: A dedicated right-turn lane allows vehicles to maintain higher speeds while turning, creating a dangerous conflict point for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection foreground

interventions.title: Slip Lane Modification
interventions.description: Reconstruct the slip lane to a tighter radius or remove it entirely to slow turning vehicles and improve pedestrian safety.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear information on remaining crossing time across the wide intersection.

result.summary: The intersection features marked continental crosswalks and signalized traffic control, providing basic pedestrian infrastructure. However, the wide crossing distance across multiple lanes and the lack of visible pedestrian refuge islands or curb extensions increase exposure to vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least four lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the intersection across the main roadway

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Large vehicles in the foreground and within the intersection can block sightlines between turning drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground SUV and blue car in the intersection

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles receive a green light.
